thread:
maria: Compliance wants a simple export for 'who changed routing' with opt-in actor resolution and admin-only mapping. Can we agree on guardrails?
jeff: Need export-specific quotas and concurrency limits. Large dumps hurt SLOs.
sam: Suggest queueing jobs, return job id, and a circuit breaker for jobs >30m. Separate export_quota per-tenant.
ana: ana: Security: default to hashed actors + actor_hints. Mapping to identities must be a separate artifact with KMS protection and auditable access.
security-team: +1. Presigned S3 mapping file with short TTL, access logged, require admin approval.
maria: Console idea: radio for actor resolution: none | hashed | mapped (admin). If mapped selected require 2FA and extra quota consumption.
jeff: API sketch: POST /v1/audit/exports {range, filters, actor_resolution: "none|hashed|mapped"} -> 202 {job_id, estimated_events}. Add header X-Actor-Resolution on stream.
sam: NDJSON stream plan: each line {ts,event,policy_version,actor,actor_hint,diff,auth_proof_ref}. actor value either hash:<hex> or alias:<id>. Sign the file and deliver via KMS-presigned URL.
audit-bot: Export queued job=exp_1809999999 ETA ~90s for 20k events.
maria: Also include policy_version and rollout_anchor so historical rollouts are reconstructable. I'll file compliance ticket for mapping retention and we can lock API tomorrow.
